# 🔒 Security Policy

## Supported Versions

The latest release and `main` branch receive active security updates.

| Version | Supported |
| :--- | :--- |
| `main` (Latest) | :white_check_mark: |
| < v1.0 | :x: |

## Reporting a Vulnerability

If you discover a potential security vulnerability in Tessera:

1. **Please do NOT report security vulnerabilities via public GitHub issues.**
2. Privately disclose the issue via GitHub's Private Vulnerability Reporting feature on the [Tessera Security Tab](https://github.com/Ashutosh-Repos/Tessera/security/advisories/new).
3. Include detailed steps to reproduce, impact assessment, and any proof-of-concept code.

We will acknowledge receipt within 48 hours and work with you on a coordinated disclosure timeline.
